content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing the same issue. I need to transfer a program from an old to a new unit. This was split from the topic 'How to retrieve program from [company_name] [product_name]'.
There is not enough information. From which [product_name] version are you transferring to which [product_name] version? What [product_name] software version do you have?
Manufacturer: [company_name]. Article No: [article_no]. Type: [product_name]. Input: 12 x DC. Output: 8 x relay/10A. Is anyone able to assist?
Hello, I have attached all the information I have.

You have an older [product_name] from around 1996/97, without software or the required cable. If the program is still running on the first-generation unit, you'll need: - [product_name] software (current version is [version_no], but older versions may also work) - [product_name] cable. If you have an RS232 interface, use the older cable with RS232 connector. Otherwise, use the newer USB cable.
I think you don't mean the old [article_no]. You probably mean the more recent [version_no]; the order number ends with [article_no].
I have attached the unit I intend to install.
The photo you attached shows a [product_name] [version_no], order number [article_no].

Hi, Open your [product_name] program in [product_name] software [version_no] and press F2. The status window will show which [product_name] can execute the program. If your device is listed, then on the bottom right side of the software you will see a device icon. Click on it or select: Tools > HW selection and switch to your device version. Once completed, download to the [product_name].

There is an old [article_no] unit. In this case, pressing F2 is not needed. A program created on [article_no] will work on all other [product_name] devices too. I am only wondering why this wasn’t mentioned earlier.

Generally, you can read a program created in [product_name] [article_no] with [product_name] software [version_no]. You will need the serial PC [product_name] cable for this and must activate transfer mode in the device. PC <-> [product_name] Then you can use device to PC transfer. After configuring the new [product_name] [version_no], you can transfer the diagram (using an Ethernet cable) to a new [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users face difficulties transferring programs between different generations of [product_name] devices, largely due to confusion around compatible versions, required cables, and software. Hardware changes and unclear compatibility add complexity, resulting in uncertainty and need for detailed technical knowledge.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward method to transfer programs between older and newer devices, including clear guidance on necessary accessories and software versions compatible with their hardware.
